title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
text:
About the role
Corvid Payments moves money for 40,000 small businesses. The Platform team owns the services every product team builds on: accounts, ledgers, and the event bus. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale these systems.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate high-throughput services in Go and Python running on Kubernetes in AWS.
- Own APIs used by internal teams: gRPC between services, REST APIs for partners.
- Evolve our event-driven architecture on Kafka, including schema evolution and exactly-once processing.
- Tune PostgreSQL and Redis for latency and cost; plan capacity ahead of peak season.
- Improve observability with Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry; take part in an on-call rotation.
- Write Terraform for the infrastructure your services need, and keep CI/CD fast.

What we look for
- 5+ years building backend services in production.
- Strong grounding in distributed systems, concurrency and system design.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes; Helm is a plus.
- A habit of writing unit tests and integration tests, and of thoughtful code review.
- BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Benefits: remote-first in the US, equity, 401(k) match. Corvid is an equal opportunity employer.
